set.body:
Outcome: users can compute comparable features and predict with one declared specification across the full public workflow.

Scope: integrate feature_spec and explicit estimators through compute_contour_properties, contour_statistics, feature_table, average_property, batch_statistics, score_branch, compute_mat_properties, analyse_mat, mapping, and predict_contours where applicable. Explicitly pass branch/mapping settings through orchestration rather than relying on unrelated defaults. Avoid changing existing argument meanings. Attach actual resolved metadata, extraction provenance, finite-support/mapping coverage, and method versions. Invalidate derived results when geometry or relevant specification fields change; reject incompatible precomputed measurements.

Acceptance:
- End-to-end synthetic drawings at differing canvas sizes/calibrations produce matching physical columns under a shared specification and different columns only when definitions differ intentionally.
- Batch schemas and model bindings reject mismatched semantics, reordered/missing predictors, and unknown estimator versions before prediction.
- Serialization preserves specifications and validity information; CSV export provides an explicit accompanying specification when attributes cannot be retained.
- Geometry transformations cannot leave stale properties falsely labeled as current. Missing or unmapped features remain distinguishable from zero scores.
- Include a minimal legacy migration example and a complete new-estimator train/predict workflow. Keep numeric mlv2023 parity unchanged while testing metadata evolution explicitly.
set.title: Carry feature specifications through public workflows and model prediction
